sources.verifiedContent: Preferences uses iOS UserDefaults and Android SharedPreferences; the documented application privacy-manifest reason is CA92.1.
CA92.1 permits app-only defaults access; it excludes other-app/system data access and cross-app accessible writes.

privacyReason.technicalBasis: Preferences.swift returns UserDefaults.standard. IosPlatformAdapter passes this plugin to HostPlatformServices; the current host policy permits only probpera-interface-language and probpera-display-mode, with bounded enum values. No App Group, MDM or third-party defaults domain is requested.
privacyReason.pending: Audit the actual linked iOS archive and SDK manifests before release, including new API usage and applicable collected-data/tracking disclosures. This one application reason is not a complete privacy declaration.

runtimeLimits: App-language declarations and app-name resources do not prove preservation of Canvas/camera/navigation on system language changes. Root-owned bridge and actual native tests must verify that contract.
No request-permission usage descriptions were added: this scope does not add camera, microphone, photos, location, tracking or notification permissions.
Explicit allowBackup=false does not by itself establish all-OEM device-to-device transfer behavior. No backup/restore/device-transfer test was performed.
Default generated branding and actual native launch visuals remain separate root work; this report asserts no screenshot, icon review or binary readiness.
